title.narrative: Ambulance and Rescue Unit Support Project of the Federal Ministry of Health of Somalia

description.narrative: Enhancing the capacity of Somali government hospitals to respond quickly to emergency cases, saving thousands of lives, especially in the event of terrorist attacks, and raising the level of performance of the government health sector in general, by supporting government hospitals with ambulances equipped with the latest modern equipment.
Reducing critical cases and deaths resulting from the failure to provide ambulatory services in emergency departments and government hospitals in Somalia, to a number of 547,500.

Supporting the emergency department in Somali government hospitals, by handing over 15 ambulances to the Somali Federal Ministry of Health, equipped according to the specifications and equipment approved by them.
